disorders.name: Schizophrenia and other psychoses

tabs.overview: Psychosis involves altered reality testing with varied course across individuals.
tabs.neuroanatomy: Structural meta-analytic findings are small on average; cite effect sizes only from sources (pending).
tabs.circuits: Dorsal striatal dopamine signalling, prefrontal E/I balance and hippocampal-VTA loop are studied (hypotheses).
tabs.psychopathology: Delusions map to salience circuits; voices to auditory networks; thought disorder to language circuits (draft).
tabs.clinical: Clinical picture combines positive, negative and cognitive features with functional impact (paraphrased).
tabs.differential: Consider mood psychosis, delirium, substance-induced and neurological causes (paraphrased).
tabs.investigations: Workup excludes medical mimics; neuroimaging when indicated (paraphrased).
tabs.management: Antipsychotic classes per guidelines; psychosocial rehabilitation alongside (no doses; formulary-check).
tabs.neuromodulation: ECT considered for catatonia or treatment resistance per guidelines; rTMS/DBS investigational (draft).
tabs.course: Course varies; early intervention and adherence support prognosis (paraphrased).
tabs.pearls: Viva: salience + dorsal striatum + prefrontal E/I; never state hypotheses as fact.
tabs.vignette: Original vignette: a young adult with new suspiciousness and voices; workup-first teaching case (draft).

mcqs.q: Salience circuit substrate in psychosis models?
Best next step for new psychosis with fever?

tour: Give one viva pearl with hypothesis label.

claims.text: Schizophrenia and other psychoses teaching pack (draft schematics).

tabs.overview: Depression combines low mood or anhedonia with cognitive and vegetative features (paraphrased).
tabs.neuroanatomy: Structural findings are small on average; cite meta-analytic effect sizes only (pending).
tabs.circuits: Subgenual ACC, amygdala, habenula and prefrontal balance are studied with DLPFC asymmetry (draft).
tabs.psychopathology: Anhedonia maps toward reward circuits; retardation toward motor loops (draft).
tabs.clinical: Clinical features span mood, interest, sleep, appetite, energy and concentration (paraphrased).
tabs.differential: Consider bipolarity, medical causes, substances and bereavement context (paraphrased).
tabs.investigations: Screen thyroid, anaemia and substances where indicated (paraphrased).
tabs.management: Antidepressant classes and psychotherapy per guidelines; no doses here (formulary-check).
tabs.neuromodulation: rTMS to DLPFC, ECT for severe/psychotic cases per guidelines (draft).
tabs.course: Recurrence is common; maintenance follows guideline algorithms (paraphrased).
tabs.pearls: Viva: sgACC + habenula + DLPFC asymmetry; anhedonia = reward circuit.
tabs.vignette: Original vignette: gradual anhedonia with early waking; measurement-based teaching case (draft).

claims.text: Major depressive disorder teaching pack (draft schematics).

tabs.overview: Bipolar disorder alternates elevated and depressive states with inter-episode recovery (paraphrased).
tabs.neuroanatomy: Structural findings overlap mood-psychosis spectra; cite effect sizes only (pending).
tabs.circuits: Mania vs depression asymmetry across prefrontal-limbic balance is studied (draft).
tabs.psychopathology: Decreased sleep need maps toward arousal circuits; impulsivity toward control circuits (draft).
tabs.clinical: Mania features elevated mood, energy, sleep loss and risk-taking (paraphrased).
tabs.differential: Consider substances, medical causes and unipolar depression course (paraphrased).
tabs.investigations: Baseline labs/ECG per agent guidelines before mood stabilisers (paraphrased).
tabs.management: Mood stabiliser + atypical classes per guidelines; no doses here (formulary-check).
tabs.neuromodulation: ECT for severe mania/depression per guidelines (draft).
tabs.course: Relapse prevention hinges on adherence and early-warning plans (paraphrased).
tabs.pearls: Viva: mania vs depression asymmetry; sleep loss is core.
tabs.vignette: Original vignette: reduced sleep with over-spending; collateral-first teaching case (draft).

claims.text: Bipolar disorder (mania / depression) teaching pack (draft schematics).

tabs.overview: OCD combines intrusive thoughts with repetitive behaviours relieving distress (paraphrased).
tabs.neuroanatomy: Orbitofronto-striatal findings are small; cite effect sizes only (pending).
tabs.circuits: Orbitofronto-striatal loop with direct/indirect imbalance is the core model (draft).
tabs.psychopathology: Urges map toward habit circuits; anxiety toward threat circuits (draft).
tabs.clinical: Clinically time-consuming rituals impair function with preserved insight often (paraphrased).
tabs.differential: Consider tics, autism-related routines and psychosis (paraphrased).
tabs.investigations: Assess severity with standard scales; medical workup rarely central (paraphrased).
tabs.management: SSRI + exposure-response prevention per guidelines; no doses (formulary-check).
tabs.neuromodulation: DBS/rTMS for refractory cases in specialist centres (draft).
tabs.course: Course is often chronic with waxing; ERP sustains gains (paraphrased).
tabs.pearls: Viva: OFC-striatal loop; ERP is first-line with SSRI.
tabs.vignette: Original vignette: contamination fears with washing; hierarchy-based teaching case (draft).

claims.text: OCD and related disorders teaching pack (draft schematics).

tabs.overview: Addiction cycles binge, withdrawal-negative affect and preoccupation-craving stages (paraphrased).
tabs.neuroanatomy: Structural findings vary by substance; cite effect sizes only (pending).
tabs.circuits: VTA-NAc reward, extended-amygdala stress and habenula anti-reward interact (draft).
tabs.psychopathology: Craving maps toward incentive circuits; withdrawal toward stress circuits (draft).
tabs.clinical: Intoxication vs withdrawal signs differ per substance class (paraphrased).
tabs.differential: Consider dual diagnosis and medical complications per substance (paraphrased).
tabs.investigations: Toxicology, liver and infectious screens where indicated (paraphrased).
tabs.management: Agonist/antagonist/aversive classes per substance guidelines; no doses (formulary-check).
tabs.course: Relapse is common; contingency and follow-up help (paraphrased).
tabs.vignette: Original vignette: craving with morning relief drinking; stage-based teaching case (draft).

claims.text: Substance use disorders teaching pack (draft schematics).

tabs.overview: Distressing bodily symptoms with disproportionate thoughts and behaviours (paraphrased).
tabs.neuroanatomy: No diagnostic structural signature; interoception circuits studied (emerging).
tabs.circuits: Insula-ACC interoceptive and pain-matrix interactions proposed (emerging).
tabs.clinical: Symptoms are genuine and impairing; function matters most (paraphrased).
tabs.differential: Rule out medical causes proportionately without over-investigation (paraphrased).
tabs.investigations: Targeted workup, then regular follow-up visits (paraphrased).
tabs.management: CBT, psychoeducation and antidepressant classes where comorbid (no doses).
tabs.neuromodulation: No routine neuromodulation; treat comorbidity per guidelines (draft).
tabs.course: Prognosis improves with continuity and function focus (paraphrased).
tabs.pearls: Viva: genuine symptoms; interoception circuits emerging.
tabs.vignette: Original vignette: multiple pains with normal workup; function-first teaching case (draft).

claims.text: Somatic symptom disorder teaching pack (draft schematics).

tabs.overview: Neurological-appearing symptoms incompatible with recognised disease patterns (paraphrased).
tabs.neuroanatomy: No diagnostic lesion; limbic-motor interaction models are emerging/hypothesis.
tabs.circuits: SMA, TPJ agency and insula-ACC circuits proposed (hypothesis).
tabs.psychopathology: Motor symptoms map toward voluntary-motor vs agency mismatch (hypothesis).
tabs.clinical: Diagnosis rests on positive inconsistency signs with examination (paraphrased).
tabs.differential: Distinguish from feigning by internal inconsistency, not accusation (paraphrased).
tabs.investigations: Video/EEG or imaging only as indicated (paraphrased).
tabs.pearls: Viva: positive signs; agency hypothesis labelled.
tabs.vignette: Original vignette: give-way weakness with Hoover sign; explanation-first case (draft).

claims.text: Conversion disorder / functional neurological disorder teaching pack (draft schematics).

tabs.overview: Anxiety disorders share excessive fear/worry with avoidance and arousal (paraphrased).
tabs.neuroanatomy: No diagnostic structural signature; threat-circuit function studied (emerging).
tabs.circuits: BLA-CeA, vmPFC extinction, BNST sustained anxiety and PAG output (draft).
tabs.psychopathology: Panic maps toward PAG + arousal; social toward evaluation circuits (draft).
tabs.clinical: GAD is broad worry; panic is abrupt surges; social is scrutiny fear (paraphrased).
tabs.differential: Consider medical (thyroid), substances and depression comorbidity (paraphrased).
tabs.investigations: Vitals, thyroid and substance review where indicated (paraphrased).
tabs.management: SSRI/SNRI + CBT per guidelines; no doses (formulary-check).
tabs.course: Course tends to persist without treatment; CBT gains hold (paraphrased).
tabs.pearls: Viva: BLA→CeA→PAG; vmPFC extinction; BNST sustained.
tabs.vignette: Original vignette: panic-like surges with normal ECG; exposure-based case (draft).

claims.text: Anxiety disorders (GAD / panic / social) teaching pack (draft schematics).

tabs.overview: PTSD follows trauma with re-experiencing, avoidance, arousal and mood shifts (paraphrased).
tabs.neuroanatomy: No diagnostic structural signature; threat-memory circuits studied (emerging).
tabs.circuits: Amygdala reactivity, vmPFC/hippocampal context and HPA tone interact (draft).
tabs.psychopathology: Flashbacks map toward memory-threat coupling; numbing toward regulation (draft).
tabs.clinical: Screen trauma type, dissociation and comorbidity sensitively (paraphrased).
tabs.differential: Distinguish from depression, TBI and prolonged grief context (paraphrased).
tabs.investigations: Medical workup only as indicated; safety first (paraphrased).
tabs.management: Trauma-focused CBT/EMDR + SSRI classes per guidelines; no doses (formulary-check).
tabs.vignette: Original vignette: nightmares after event with avoidance; phased teaching case (draft).

claims.text: Post-traumatic stress disorder teaching pack (draft schematics).
